templates.name: variables

service_name.description: The name of the service (e.g., payment-service-data). Used for S3 bucket naming. Must be 3-63 lowercase alphanumeric characters and hyphens. Note: S3 bucket names must be globally unique across all AWS accounts - consider appending environment or random suffix.

aws_region.description: The AWS region to deploy the S3 bucket.

performance_profile.description: The performance tier selected by the developer (sandbox, development, production). Versioning and lifecycle rules are automatically configured based on this profile.

additional_tags.description: Additional tags to apply to the S3 bucket (optional).
